attributes.board_name: Delaware Board of Examiners of Psychologists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities from APA-approved CE sponsors accepted automatically; other courses may be submitted to the Board for approval via DELPROS service request
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal prorated by issue date: 30 h (2 ethics, 2 diversity) if issued Aug 1 odd year - Feb 1 even year; 20 h (1+1) if Feb 1 - Aug 1 even year; 10 h (1+1) if Aug 1 even - Feb 1 odd year; 0 h if issued Feb 1 - Aug 1 odd year.
rules.audit_note: CE entered in the DELPROS CE tracker; random audits - upload certificates (and agendas/syllabi for non-APA courses) only when selected.
rules.notes: Licensure period Aug 1 of an odd year to July 31 of the next odd year. At least 10 h face to face or live webinar. Diversity topic is named 'cultural inclusion, equity and diversity'.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities from APA-approved CE sponsors accepted automatically; other courses may be submitted to the Board for approval
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal prorated by issue date: 15 h, 10 h, 5 h or 0 h depending on the half-year of issue (each with ethics and diversity hours).
rules.audit_note: CE entered in the DELPROS CE tracker; random audits.
rules.notes: Same Board and odd-year period (Aug 1 - July 31) as psychologists.
